messages:
Sophie L: Heads up — noticed a few function-calling examples in the docs that 404 after the recent example-refactor. Links under /docs/guides/invoke/ are pointing to old paths. Thinking we should: add a short migration note, surface a tiny SDK shim snippet for compat, and patch the examples + tests.

Alex M: Thanks, Sophie. Can you drop a quick list of broken URLs? I can open a single PR that fixes examples + adds the migration note.

Sophie L: Quick list I found so far: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/blob/main/guides/invoke/old-tool-examples.md -> 404, and the sample app link to github.com/redwood-inference/example-invoke-app/tree/refactor-target. Also the embed snippet in the structured-output page still uses the old `tools.call` helper.

Morgan: FYI the SDK shim we discussed last sprint was tiny — basically aliasing the old helpers to the new call API. Something like: ```js
// compatibility shim (temporary)
import { call as newCall } from '@redwood/inference-sdk';
export function toolsCall(tool, input) {
  return newCall({ toolName: tool, input });
}
```
Works for our internal examples until we migrate all snippets.

Ryan P: +1 for a short-lived shim. Also want to add one unit test for the docs example harness so link checks fail the build if we break things again. We can reuse the docs link-check action with a whitelist.

Alex M: I'll open a PR in docs repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482 with three commits: 1) fix broken links, 2) add migration note under /guides/invoke/, 3) add compatibility shim snippet and a short example update.

Sophie L: Perfect. Can you also add an inline note near the shim: "temporary — remove after snippets migrated" and a TODO referencing the PR number?

Alex M: Yep. Will tag this thread in the PR body and add reviewers @Morgan and @Sophie L.

redwood-docs-bot: deploy-check queued for docs PR #1482 — link-check, lint, example-harness. (status: queued) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Morgan: One more edge case — structured output section expects a JSON Schema example that uses `additionalProperties: false`. When we swap tool outputs to the new call shape, some examples add an envelope `{result: ...}` which will break the schema. Suggest we add a short note in the schema example about acceptable envelopes, and provide both shapes: "raw tool result" and "enveloped result". Keeps parsers clear.

Sophie L: Good catch. Add a tiny snippet showing both shapes and a parsing hint: prefer `result = candidate.result ?? candidate` in examples.

Alex M: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1482 (draft). Assigning to @Morgan for the schema bit, @Sophie L for wording. ETA EOD tomorrow for first pass.

Ryan P: I'll add a test in docs/actions/link-check.yml to fail on 404s for changed files. If it causes noise, we'll add a small whitelist.

Sophie L: Thanks team — small coordination notes: 1) mark shim as "compat: short-term" in code comment, 2) add migration note to top of invoke guide, 3) update structured-output schema examples to show enveloped/raw shapes and parsing hint.

Alex M: Will do. Ping me here if anything blocks the PR review. :thumbsup:

redwood-docs-bot: CI status for PR #1482: link-check passed, lint passed, example-harness failed (1 test) — failing test: sample-invoke-app path mismatch. See CI logs: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/teams/docs/runs/5678

Sophie L: I'll take the failing test — probably a path that still points to the old example app.

Morgan: When you fix that, let's also add a short section in the guide about how to run the example harness locally: `yarn docs:test-examples` so engineers can reproduce.

Alex M: Updated PR to address CI feedback (commit 3). Marking draft -> ready for review. @Morgan @Sophie L please review when you get a sec.

Sophie L: Reviewed and left one wording nit. Approving after nit is addressed.

Morgan: Approved.

Alex M: Merged main -> docs (PR #1482 merged). Thanks all. :tada:

Sophie L: Great — follow-up action: schedule a quick sweep next week to remove the shim after we've migrated the last 3 examples (I'll create a tracking issue).
